capabilities: Generate AI content from selected text as the prompt
Replace the selected text with the generated result
Trigger generation from a ribbon button or command palette command
Configure a Google AI Studio API key and choose the AI model in settings
extras: Plans OpenRouter and other AI service support, insert-without-replace mode, and custom prompt templates, so scope may grow beyond Gemini-only generation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate AI content inside notes, so users must leave the app to prompt a model and paste results back.

relations.evidence: integrates with AI services like Google Gemini

summary: AI generation plugin that sends selected note text as a prompt to Google Gemini and replaces it with the model's response.
